_about: v2.4 plan 06 F5 Phase A. Labels frozen 2026-09-25 by the plan-06 build, BEFORE any model answer was read (v2.3 plan-10 audit rule). A 'propose' case has an entity established by >=2 live facts and no entry; the sample passes when >=1 create card survives the code guards AND names the case's entity. A 'none' case passes only when no create card survives. Floors declared in the plan before the run: propose >= 0.90 of samples, none = 1.00 of samples. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case instead. v2.6 W25 removed the nine Spanish cases (p08-p11, n07-n11); p12-p15 and n12-n16 are English cases added 2026-10-01 (v2.6 plan 15, AS-16), labelled before any model answer was read, to restore the declared >= 22 cases and >= 10 of each label. Their ids are new so no earlier record can be read as theirs.

cases.label: propose

entries.content: A drowned plain of reeds and channels between the salt flats and the sea. Only a ferry crosses it safely.

facts: Oskar the ferryman charges one silver coin per crossing of the delta.
Oskar knows the smugglers' channel through the reeds and has used it before.
Mira distrusts Oskar since he overcharged her brother.
cases.canon: Mira and Tolan reached the delta at dusk and hired Oskar, the old ferryman, who hinted at a faster, hidden channel.
